name: Gadsme
what_it_is: An in-game advertising platform that renders ads as native in-world assets for mobile, PC and console games through a proprietary SDK.
platforms: Mobile, PC and console; Unity, Unreal and C++ engines
pricing: Not stated on the opened pages; visitors are asked to request a demo.
notable: Founded in early 2020; the about page says co-founder Simon Spaull spent seven years at AppLovin before Gadsme

facts.fact: Gadsme describes its product as an in-game advertising platform with ads built into gameplay for mobile, PC and console.
The publisher page says the SDK is compatible with Unity, Unreal and all C++ proprietary engines.
The publisher page says publishers typically achieve 8% to 20% ARPDAU uplift (vendor figure) and ads render as native assets with no overlays.
The about page says Gadsme was founded in early 2020 on 100% proprietary technology built in-house.
The homepage offers Request a demo and states no price.

name: Venatus
what_it_is: A gaming and entertainment advertising company whose Prosper platform covers publisher ad management, mediation and in-game, around-the-game and away-from-the-game ad placements.
platforms: Websites, apps and browser games (per the navigation)
pricing: Not stated on the opened page; visitors are asked to request a demo.
notable: Homepage states 900+ directly sold campaigns every year (vendor figure)
Homepage says it is a Google Certified Publishing Partner

facts.fact: Venatus describes itself as a gaming and entertainment advertising growth engine and names its platform Prosper.
The navigation lists Ad-Mediation, App Monetization, Browser Game Monetization and ad placements In the Game, Around the Game and Away from the Game.
The homepage says Venatus runs 900+ directly sold campaigns every year (vendor figure).
The homepage says in-game campaigns are shown to be up to 63% more memorable than standard ads, a vendor claim.
Pricing is not stated and the homepage offers a Request demo button.
